title: Add unit tests for cube viewer pure functions
description: Wire up shadow-cljs :node-test build target and cover the pure functions in cube.core: vector helpers (v-, v*, vdot, vlen, vnorm), matrix helpers (mat-rot-x/y/z, mat-mul, mat-apply, euler->mat, mat->euler), deg-mod, project, shade, rgb->css, face-render-data, and geometry constants. Skip side-effecting DOM/canvas code.
close_reason: Added shadow-cljs :node-test build + test/cube/core_test.cljs covering vectors, matrices, Euler conversions, projection, shading, rgb->css, and face-render-data. 26 tests / 124 assertions pass. Run via 'npm test'.

title: Build Flappy Bird ClojureScript game in ./bird
description: Create a Flappy Bird-style game playable in the browser. ClojureScript + shadow-cljs canvas rendering. Should follow conventions of existing ball/cube/chart projects (shadow-cljs.edn, package.json, public/index.html, src/<ns>/...).

title: Fix gimbal feel for vertical drag in cube viewer
description: Vertical drag feels wrong once Y rotation is non-zero (which it is by default). Replace Euler-only rotation state with a 3x3 rotation matrix. Sliders rebuild the matrix from Euler; drag composes world-axis Rx(dy)*Ry(dx) onto the matrix and syncs sliders by extracting Euler back out.
close_reason: Switched rotation state from raw Euler to a 3x3 matrix. Sliders rebuild the matrix via euler->mat; drag left-multiplies world-axis Rx(dy)*Ry(dx) onto a matrix snapshot taken at mousedown, so vertical drag always tilts around screen-horizontal regardless of current orientation. mat->euler back-fills slider values during drag.

title: Docker deploy for landing page
description: Multi-stage Dockerfile that builds ball, cube, and landing shadow-cljs apps, then merges into a single static tree served by nginx. docker-compose.yml at repo root exposes the site. Include .dockerignore to keep node_modules/build caches out of the build context.
close_reason: Multi-stage Dockerfile builds ball/cube/landing release bundles, merges under landing/public, served by nginx:alpine with gzip + immutable JS cache. docker-compose.yml exposes 8090:80. Verified: all routes return 200 (/, /js/main.js, /ball/, /ball/js/main.js, /cube/, /cube/js/main.js). Final image 76 MB.

title: Add click-drag X/Y rotation and scroll zoom to cube viewer
description: Click-drag on the canvas rotates the cube around X and Y (mouse-Y → :rx, mouse-X → :ry) and keeps the existing sliders in sync. Scroll wheel zooms by adjusting camera distance. Sliders continue to work; drag updates them too.
close_reason: Drag adds X/Y rotation (mouse-Y → :rx, mouse-X → :ry, 0.5°/px), scroll wheel zooms via :cam (clamped 2.5..20). Drag and sliders stay in sync via sync-slider!. Canvas shows grab/grabbing cursor.

title: Make light source position movable via sliders
description: Add X/Y/Z sliders for the colored point light in cube/ so the user can drag the light around and watch shading change in real time. Move light-pos from a const into the state atom and wire it through shade + draw-light-glow!.
close_reason: Light source now movable via three new sliders (X/Y/Z, -5..5). light-pos lives in the state atom; shade and draw-light-glow! take it as a parameter. Glow also scales with depth and hides when the light is behind the camera.

title: Landing page in ClojureScript for vibe exercises
description: Add a sibling shadow-cljs project that renders a landing page with cards for the ball and cube exercises. Mirror the structure of the existing exercises (shadow-cljs.edn, deps.edn, package.json, public/index.html, src/landing/core.cljs). Cards link out to each exercise.
close_reason: Built landing/ shadow-cljs project. Renders cards for ball + cube with live animated previews (real bouncing physics + rotating wireframe). Release build compiles clean, dev server serves index correctly to browsers (shadow-cljs content-negotiates on Accept: text/html).

title: Build ClojureScript cube viewer with colored light and orientation sliders
description: Create ./cube directory containing a shadow-cljs project that renders a 3D cube via Three.js with a colored light source. UI exposes slider bars for X/Y/Z rotation of the cube. Self-contained: shadow-cljs.edn, package.json, public/index.html, src/cube/core.cljs.
close_reason: Built cube viewer: shadow-cljs project with 3D cube, warm-orange point light, Lambert shading, and X/Y/Z rotation sliders. Compiles cleanly with 0 warnings.
